Name: Pelipper Expander PokeManager
Author: son03052003
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pelipper Expander PokeManager[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]One window to manage every Pokémon Hut around your chest[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Description[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Pelipper Expander PokeManager[/b] is a companion mod for [b]Pelipper Town[/b]. It adds a clean [b]Pokémon Manager[/b] window next to your Pokémon Chest, so you can look after dozens of Pokémon Huts without walking to each one.

It does [b]not[/b] change or redistribute Pelipper Town. Every assign, unassign, chore and delivery change goes through Pelipper Town's own hut commands, so all of its rules still apply (blocked doors, water-only Pokémon, one resident per hut, owner checks). If something is refused, you get a readable reason instead of a silent failure.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b] and [b]Pelipper Town 1.2.7 or newer[/b] (with the mods it requires, such as SpaceCore).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Copy the folder [b]pelipper_expander_pokemanager[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI. The SMAPI log should say that Pelipper Town was detected and that the bridge was validated.[/*]
[*]Stand within 3 tiles of a [b]Pokémon Chest[/b] and press [b]K[/b] (rebindable) to open the Manager.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Main features[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Evolve tab[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Lists every boxed Pokémon that Pelipper Town would let evolve, with avatars for the Pokémon and its evolution target(s).[/*]
[*]Evolve one, or evolve all ready Pokémon one after another. Pelipper Town's own evolution dialogue is used, so route choices and animations stay intact.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Huts tab[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Overview:[/b] every Pokémon Hut inside the managed area, with position, distance, resident, HP and energy bars, chore chips and item delivery.[/*]
[*][b]Detail panel:[/b] click a hut to toggle each chore and to switch item delivery between the chest and you. Chores a Pokémon cannot do are marked with a red X.[/*]
[*][b]Search, filter, sort:[/b] search by name, species or x,y. Filter by Empty / Occupied, delivery target and chores ("Has all": a Pokémon must be able to do [i]all[/i] the chosen chores). Sort by position, distance, name, level or energy.[/*]
[*][b]Assign:[/b] a large picker with accent-insensitive search, sorting, minimum level, chore filter and a picture of every Pokémon. Pokémon that cannot be placed are dimmed, with the reason.[/*]
[*][b]Unassign / Unassign all:[/b] unassign all asks for confirmation.[/*]
[*][b]Template and sync:[/b] set a hut as template, then sync its chores and delivery to all huts or only the ticked ones.[/*]
[*][b]Safe batch actions:[/b] they never stop at the first problem and report "N ok, M failed (most common reason)".[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Quick assign in 3 steps[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Tick the empty huts you want to fill, then press [b]Quick assign[/b]. A green box next to the button shows it is on.[/*]
[*]Choose the chores in the [b]Has all[/b] filter. While Quick assign is on, this filter only picks the Pokémon and does not hide any huts. The button lights up.[/*]
[*]Press the button again. Free Pokémon that can do every chosen chore fill the ticked huts, and the list switches to [b]All[/b] so you can see who was placed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Radius up to 100 tiles[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The managed area is a radius around the chest: [b]5 = 11x11[/b] tiles, [b]100 = 201x201[/b] tiles.[/*]
[*]Use the -10 / -1 / +1 / +10 buttons or type a number and press Enter.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Vietnamese language option[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Turn on [b]Vietnamese[/b] in the settings to show the whole Manager in Vietnamese.[/*]
[*]A bundled pixel font (VT323) makes sure every Vietnamese letter displays correctly. Pokémon names and nicknames are not translated, and Lv / HP / id stay as they are.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Edit [b]config.json[/b], use [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional), or use the SMAPI console: [font=Courier New]pe_config[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_set <Key> <Value>[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_reset[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_range <radius>[/font].[/*]
[*]Values are clamped to safe limits and apply immediately, no restart needed.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]pe_huts[/font] prints a diagnostic line about how many huts were found in range.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 and [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b][/*]
[*][b]Pelipper Town 1.2.7 or newer[/b] (and the mods it requires, such as SpaceCore)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [i](optional, for in-game settings)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[i]Multiplayer note: Pelipper Town requires the player to stand within 3 tiles of a hut. On the host or in single player the Manager handles this for you. A farmhand can only manage huts they are standing next to.[/i]
